question: Does the sequence li+ame represent a recurrent compositional Rarámuri construction across independent lexical roots and varieties, rather than an idiosyncratic property of Western newálime?

direct_segmented_evidence.role: structural control showing li + ame stacking is grammatical

western_surface_evidence: newalime ju in a 2010 Lowland/Western title
newálime jú in the Oeste column of Manual Ralámuli 2019
root_families.assessment: Strong evidence for internal li material and independent -ami nominalization; Western newálime exact segmentation remains a preferred working hypothesis rather than an authoritative segmentation.

direct_or_same_root_controls.source: Compendio básico de la gramática ralámuli 1997
Compendio básico de la gramática ralámuli 1997
direct_or_same_root_controls.assessment: The same kill root participates in the passive domain, where the grammar explicitly discusses passive -li combined with -ru; OCR prevents reliable recovery of the exact surface strings.
Same Western lexical family displays finite -le, -ame, and extensive li-surface profiles.

root_families.assessment: Second Western lexical-root replication. M1 me'+PASS -li+PTCP/NMLZ -ame is the strongest working hypothesis; derived/allomorphic me'li- + -ame remains a serious alternative.

direct_segmented_evidence.translation_context: al que le dicen San Isidro

western_surface_evidence.source: Manual Ralámuli Escrito para Todas y Todos 2019
western_surface_evidence.access_note: Form read from an indexed digital copy; official existence and interinstitutional provenance of the Manual are independently verified by UPNECH/Government of Chihuahua.

western_surface_evidence.assessment: Highly recurrent natural-language form in 'called/named X' contexts; TAC provides no interlinear segmentation.

western_surface_evidence.context: contrast between '¿Cómo le dicen a usted?' and '¿Cómo se nombra usted?'

root_families.assessment: Third-root replication and the clearest direct demonstration that ani + li + ame is compositionally analyzable in contemporary Rarámuri. Western surface forms independently converge on the same chain.

methodological_consequence: The argument can now distinguish constructional productivity from historical cognacy. A recurrent li+ame chain is directly documented across roots/varieties, but each historical correspondence still requires lexeme- and morpheme-specific adjudication.
prohibited_inferences: Do not infer one universal semantic value for every -li token across newa-, me'á- and ani-.
Do not normalize OCR-damaged anilfame to anilíame without facsimile verification.
Do not transfer Munérachi segmentation automatically to Western forms.
Do not promote constructional productivity to historical cognacy with Steffel -ameke without additional evidence.
next_tests: Find a fourth lexical root with directly segmented li+ame in a primary linguistic source.
Search the Manual and Munérachi texts for binilíame/other liame forms and establish roots independently.
Build a Western TAC concordance for anilime, newalime and me'li... and classify syntactic environments without automatic segmentation.
Compare historical Steffel forms based on cognate ani-/newa-/me'a roots only if lexical continuity can be independently established.
